blocks.title: fiercely independent
blocks.html:
adverb + adjective

  • My mother is 84 and still fiercely independent — she refuses to let anyone help.
  • The newspaper has stayed fiercely independent through three changes of owner.
  • Adolescents are fiercely independent in theory and deeply conformist in practice.

CA: ferotgement independent

ES: ferozmente independiente

'Fiercely' intensifies effortful qualities: loyal, protective, competitive, proud. Not *fiercely tired.

blocks.title: Tug of war — UK vs US culture
a steep learning curve
blocks.html:
adjective + noun

  • The first month was a steep learning curve — I'd never used that software.
  • New doctors face a steep learning curve in their first year on the wards.
  • Any career change involves a steep learning curve, but the pay-off can be considerable.

CA: una corba d'aprenentatge molt pronunciada

ES: una curva de aprendizaje muy pronunciada

'Steep' means hard and fast, not slow. Common error: *a high learning curve.
